observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation console with a DualShock-style controller in front; controller has a custom/painted look and a visible PS button area.
Photo 0 also shows a second controller partially/behind the main controller (appears like another DualShock).
Photo 1 shows the console clearly from the front with the controller in the foreground; the console screen/label area is not readable.
No photo shows the console model number (CUH/PS4/PS4 Pro) or the storage capacity.
No photo shows the disc drive status, ports, serial number, or the games list.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 appears to show more than one controller (one is clearly visible and another is partially visible), but it’s not clear if it’s a second pad or just an object/angle.
No photo shows the PS4 game library/storage screen or a games list.
No photo shows the installed game titles on the console.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model (CUH version / PS4 vs PS4 Pro) is not readable, which affects value and pricing.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label showing the model number (CUH-xxxx) and region, plus a close-up of the back ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used PS4 (worst-case: not Pro).

risks.risk: Whether the console is fully functional (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, USB ports) is unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing the console powering on to the home screen, then opening Settings > System Information (or a game launch).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume issues until proven (worst-case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Controller count and condition (drift, button issues) is unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing both sticks/buttons responding (e.g., controller test screen) and confirm whether it’s exactly 1 pad or 2.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 1 controller in average condition (worst-case: only one working pad).

risks.risk: Pre-installed games claim may be inaccurate (missing titles, corrupted installs, account restrictions).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/screenshot of the PS4 home screen or Library showing the installed games list (including FIFA/PES/GTA titles).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (worst-case: no usable pre-installed games).

risks.risk: Storage size is unknown; smaller HDD/SSD reduces value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of Settings > Storage (or System Information showing HDD capacity).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lowest common storage for used PS4.

proof_requests: Photo of the console label with the full model number (CUH-xxxx) and region (on the back/bottom).
Video: power on to PS4 home screen + Settings > System Information (or Storage) to confirm model and capacity.
Video or screenshot of the installed games list/library showing the claimed titles.
Confirm controller count (exactly 1 pad) and show a quick controller test for stick drift/button response.
response.reason: From the photos, it’s clearly a PS4 with at least one controller, but the PS4 model, storage, controller count/condition, and the installed games list are not verifiable. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
